turns.content: Cube S1 has volume 125. Calculate its edge length a1.
Sphere S_n is circumscribed about cube C_n and inscribed in cube C_{n+1}. Relate the diameter of S_n to the edge lengths a_n and a_{n+1}.
Use the space diagonal of a cube to derive the recurrence for a_{n+1} in terms of a_n.
Check the recurrence geometrically by comparing the circumsphere radius of C_n with the insphere radius of C_{n+1}.
Let V_n be the volume of S_n. Derive closed forms for a_n and V_n using the cube recurrence.
Calculate the edge lengths and volumes of C2 and C3.
Find the least k for which V_k is at least 2019, and give the edge length of C_k.
